copy.pickerLine: Sign in on Upstox’s page each day. Free.
copy.formLede: Upstox lets an app read your holdings once you create an app of your own and sign in to it each day. Upstox allows one app per person, so this replaces any other tool you connected through an Upstox app.
steps: Sign in to account.upstox.com/developer/apps and create an app.
Paste the redirect URL below into the app’s redirect URL.
Copy the app’s API key and secret into the fields below.
Save, then sign in on Upstox’s page. You come back here.
copy.saveNote: Maester asks Upstox only for your holdings. It never places an order.
copy.signedOutNote: Upstox signs Maester out every morning at 3:30.
